reason: The named lab and the batch report are what I always ask for, and the $24.99 launch price plus the money-back guarantee makes one box an easy risk. I would try one box, not two.
objection: $29.99 after the launch price is more than I pay for a big bottle of magnesium at the store, and I forget my vitamins anyway, so I might not finish the 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open or the batch number did not match, I would pass. A regular price under $25 would make me buy two boxes.
